tools.name: query_php_docs
tools.description: Read one current English manual page for a PHP symbol or a WordPress function, hook, or class. Returns the official page URL, the version line, the signature, the description, and the first official example. php.net pages are the live English HTML manual. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "check_php_upgrade" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_php_docs, check_php_upgrade · Private data: query_php_docs · Public sink: query_php_docs, explain_php_error, check_php_upgrade.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_php_docs, check_php_upgrade · Private data: query_php_docs · Public sink: query_php_docs, explain_php_error, check_php_upgrade

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
